description: Onboard Alibaba Cloud, AWS, or Tencent Cloud accounts and system roles into IDaaS EIAM. Use for cloud account onboarding, multi-cloud identity management, onboarding verification, interrupted setup resume, local input/preflight checks, and onboarding error recovery, including missing target IDs. For input, site or profile collection only, obtain the reply and stop without CLI/API calls. Excludes application SSO, cross-instance transfer and general permission administration.
